explainer.what_it_means: Researchers demonstrated a physical attack method called FATCAT that uses electromagnetic signals to interfere with the physical memory chips of AI hardware. This allows restricted requests to be fulfilled and can cause physical systems, such as robotic arms, to behave hazardously.

stories.headline: FATCAT physical fault injection attacks eliminate LLM and vision-language model refusal
